messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy completed to eu2: service/inference v2.24.0 -> v2.25.0 (rollout 8%). commit b7e2c3. canary checks nominal.

rachel: quick note — synthetic tail-latency probe for /v1/generate spiked at +80s post-rollout. p99 jumped 600ms -> 3.2s, small # of 524 timeouts.

tom: thanks. is it across hosts or concentrated?

sre-lee: concentrated on eu2-node-3 and eu2-node-6. tcp CLOSE_WAIT increased on those hosts; no OOMs or pod restarts.

ops-ana: Recommend pausing rollout and rerouting eu2 to previous release while we triage. runbook: routectl set-route --region eu2 --target release:v2.24.0 --weight 100 --reason "post-deploy p99 spike"

release-nina: Pausing rollout now. No further batches until cleared.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by release-nina.

ops-ana: Applied route change: eu2 -> release:v2.24.0 (effective). Queued quarantine for eu2-node-3 and eu2-node-6.

rachel: Re-run synth after diversion — tail latencies returned to baseline within 30s. No new customer 5xx reported.

sre-lee: Captured flamegraphs and netstat snapshots from the two hosts; filing INF-4410 for detailed RCA and a follow-up to add per-host socket sampling to canary checks.

release-nina: Adding INF-4410 to release actions and marking release as "paused - region reverted". We'll retest once mitigation is in.

ops-ana: Note left in deploy channel: "diverted eu2 to v2.24.0 at 12:02Z; quarantined eu2-node-3/6; rollback not performed."

rachel: thanks all — will attach traces to INF-4410. :mag_right:
